title: Musurgia universalis Tomus II
shelf_note: Kircher's Musurgia universalis (Rome, 1650), Lib. VIII 'Musurgia Mirifica'. The leaf is a 17th-century print, as catalogued. No tradition or collection is given to test against.
structure_note: In the structure counts pages_translated is 0, but the pages_translated field says 519, so one of the two counters is wrong (E2). Record 27 has printed page 15, which fits about 12 leaves of front matter. 4 printed_backsteps and 17 printed_repeats in a book with many plates and tables probably come from misread folios or unnumbered plate leaves, not a splice. This one page cannot confirm that.

pages.layout: running head with page number; one column of prose above a large table (three vertical music staves, an Arabic index column 22 to 1, a Roman column I to XXII, and a column of large numbers); two lines of prose below; catchword 'intra'; faint marginal note at the top right; show-through from the verso

items.quote: The Wonderful Art of Musical Composition
A vertical diagram and table for calculating musical combina

missing.english: and so you will proceed in order up to 22, which will be the ordinary combination of the number 22
missing.why: 'Ordinary combination' is Kircher's term for the full product 22×21×…×1 (what we call a factorial). Without a gloss a general reader cannot tell what the phrase means.

book_verdict: A good page. The prose and all 22 printed figures in the table are transcribed and translated faithfully. The faults are in the apparatus: an image description, shown to the reader as a note, gets the table's columns wrong, and the table has invented headers. Nothing a reader would flag on sight.
